semantic_fragments.content: For clause 14.13 regarding PEMS incorporated into IT-NETWORK: The device is not incorporated into an IT-NETWORK, therefore all sub-requirements under clause 14.13 are marked N/A. Requirements include providing instructions for: purpose of connection, required IT-NETWORK characteristics, required configuration, technical and security specifications, intended information flow and routing, list of hazardous situations from IT-NETWORK failure. Accompanying documents for RESPONSIBLE ORGANIZATION must include statements about risks from IT-NETWORK connections and notifications about additional analysis requirements for network changes.

Clause 15.2: Parts of ME EQUIPMENT subject to mechanical wear, electrical, environmental degradation or ageing are marked N/A with remark 'No such parts.' Inspection, servicing, replacement, and adjustment of parts is also N/A with remark 'Only a qualified personnel service is available to implement.'

Clause 15.3.2 Push test specification: External parts of ENCLOSURE subjected to steady force of 250 N ± 10 N for 5 seconds applied to a circular (30mm) plane surface, except bottom of ENCLOSURE of ME EQUIPMENT weighing more than 18 kg, using a suitable test tool. Result: See Appended Table 15.3. Verdict: Pass. No damage resulting in unacceptable RISK sustained.

Clause 15.3.3 Impact test specification: Complete ENCLOSURE or its largest non-reinforced area subjected to a free falling 500 g ±25 g solid smooth steel ball approximately 50 mm in diameter dropped from a height of 1.3 m. Exception: HAND-HELD ME EQUIPMENT and parts. Verdict: N/A.
